activity.notes: Apepi (Apophis) is securely attested as a Hyksos Fifteenth-Dynasty ruler. The Rhind Mathematical Papyrus was copied in his 33rd regnal year, but absolute regnal boundaries remain disputed; ATLAS therefore uses a c.1550 BCE representative point rather than inventing an exact reign.
